user.title: Add Signal Light
user.description: Configure a new Signal Light instance that will manage a physical light entity using a three-layer priority model (base / accent / signal).

data_description.name: A friendly name for this signal light instance (e.g. 'Living Room Signal Light').
data_description.signal_wake_priority: Signals must have a priority greater than this value to turn the light on while the base layer is off.
data_description.underlying_entity_id: The light entity that Signal Light will control.

error.entity_not_found: The selected entity was not found. Please choose a valid light entity.
error.already_configured: This light entity is already managed by another Signal Light instance.

abort.already_configured: This light entity is already configured.
